verdict.rationale: Activepieces has a first-party durable-execution architecture page stating that interrupted runs resume from their last checkpoint rather than restarting, which covers the survive-restarts part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows workflows that pause and wait for days, such as delay or wait steps. The only durability evidence is a single short doc line. missing for 10: documented multi-day wait/delay steps, details of how state persists across worker vs. platform restarts, independent or hands-on corroboration of checkpoint resumption.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run long-lived workflows that wait for days and survive worker or platform restarts without losing state

citations.quote: Interrupted runs resume from their last checkpoint instead of starting over
